description: Where a `cmux` call of the Chief (its turns, subagents and acpmux) goes, the same rule for a Chief that the cmux-next app started and one that `cmux chief` started without the app. The brain host (optchat-chief host.rs session_env) writes `turn_env` from `host`; the cmux CLI (cmux-tui cli/chief_target.rs) reads that env and the sockets that exist. Rule: if the app control socket (CMUX_SOCKET_PATH) and the app's daemon (CMUX_APP_DAEMON_SOCKET) exist, daemon commands go to the app's daemon and app commands to the app. Else daemon commands go to the Chief's owner daemon (CMUX_CHIEF_OWNER_SOCKET) and app commands answer that they need the cmux app. `sockets` lists the paths that exist as sockets. `expect.daemon` is the socket of `cmux workspace list`; `expect.app` is the socket of `cmux window list`, or null when that command needs the app. Each case runs with `case_environment` (a turn env as `turn_env`), its paths relative to one directory.

cases.name: the app runs: its daemon and its control socket
no app (cmux chief without the app): the owner daemon, app commands need the app
the app quit and left its daemon: the owner daemon
a stale control link without the app's daemon: the owner daemon
